title: How You’ll Be Evaluated
intro: Your BYOB grade is split three ways: what you do, what you deliver, and how your team says you showed up. The revenue number is only one part of it.

components.name: BYOB Execution
components.body: This is the work that gets you to revenue: how sharp your customer definition is, how real your market validation is, how coherent your brand is, and how consistently you're executing on your go-to-market plan. It's reviewed in your weekly mentor check-in and scored against your BYOB Progress Card.

criteria.body: how clearly you've defined and validated exactly who you're selling to
how real the gap is that you're going after, backed by actual interviews or demand signals, not assumptions
how coherent your positioning is across your store, social handles, ad creatives, and packaging
whether you're consistently showing up and executing across your chosen channels, week over week

components.note: GTM Execution alone carries most of the weight here, strategy documents matter, but consistent weekly execution is what moves this score.

components.name: BYOB Outcomes
components.body: This is the number everyone talks about: revenue against your weekly target, tracked and verified. Your score scales directly with what you generate in Term 1:

components.name: BYOB Peer Review
components.body: At the end of the challenge, your teammates rate how you showed up, going by what they saw, not what you say you did. Three things get evaluated:

criteria.body: how effectively you work within your founding team
whether your effort is visible and consistent to the people next to you
whether you surface and handle disagreement constructively instead of letting it fester

components.note: This part of your grade is entirely in your teammates' hands. A strong revenue number doesn't cover for being a bad teammate.

cgpaNote: Your final BYOB scores can impact up to 20% of your CGPA. Full detail comes at the grading session during orientation.
